question: A sudden and constant rainfall, along with violent thunder and lightning is called the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Burst of the monsoon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Burst of the monsoon:-**

 
 
• **The burst of the monsoon is the sudden onset of the monsoon rains, which typically occurs in June in India. **
 
• **It is characterized by a sudden increase in rainfall and humidity, along with thunderstorms and lightning. **
 
• The burst of the monsoon is a welcome relief from the hot and dry pre-monsoon weather, but it can also bring with it severe weather conditions, such as flooding and landslides.
 
• The burst of the monsoon is caused by a number of factors, including:
 
 
• **The northward movement of the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)**, a belt of low pressure and high rainfall that encircles the equator.
 
• **The onset of the southwesterly monsoon winds**, which bring moisture from the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal to India.
 
• **The heating of the land surface,** which creates instability in the atmosphere.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cloudburst Monsoon:-**

 
 
• ** A cloudburst monsoon is a sudden and intense rainfall event that occurs during the monsoon season. **
 
• Cloudbursts can dump large amounts of rain in a short period of time, often over a small area.
 
• This can lead to flash floods, landslides, and other damage.
 
 
 
• **Onset of the monsoon**
 
 
• **The onset of the monsoon is the time when the monsoon winds reach a certain region and begin to bring significant rainfall. **
 
• The monsoon is a seasonal reversal of winds that brings rain to many parts of the world, including India.
